review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario, reviewed without any candidate. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly fixed hypothetical source input, not a registered human Decision; the empty decision-input fingerprint and humanConfirmed=false are consistent with that distinction. Only the selected branch is required. This supports ready with no blocking reasons for C, while a materially unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions before later gates. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001 and the task keys remain stable. The acceptance criteria consistently require identity-preserving custom rejection, explicit undefined distinguished from omission, and preservation of running-task and rejectOnClear=false behavior. The supplied source establishes index.js and the separately maintained index.d.ts as implementation/declaration owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts covering runtime and tsd verification. The exact four-file binding scope is appropriate without requiring unnecessary edits to correct forwarding or Pick-based declaration consumers; package.json supplies inspection evidence for xo && ava && tsd, not a required configuration change. Implementation and dependent independent verification are consistent with the specified all-AC coverage obligations. The supplied active scoped capability claims, roles, auto-assignable memberships and availability support the two allowed assignees without relying on persona or pending claims. A separate online project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed. No tools, code execution, human attestation, task dispatch or repository modification is claimed. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
